run_game_to_html_cli: run the CLI tool to convert a Diplomacy game JSON file into an HTML report
run_game_to_html_with_title: run the CLI tool to convert a game JSON to HTML with a custom title
run_game_to_html_with_annotations: run the CLI tool to convert a game JSON to HTML with annotation config
run_game_to_html_filter1: run the CLI tool with --filter1 to show only one power filter instead of two
run_game_to_html_custom_output: run the CLI tool to output the generated HTML to a custom file path
